device_drafts.name: restore writes the saved text into the composer and sends nothing to the PTY
text typed on this device before the answer is never overwritten
changes save as debounced patches; the last one wins; empty removes
a failed save retries on the next change
reading anchor is found by its line text, or reported missing

push_settings.name: reading the state never prompts for permission
enable prompts once, subscribes with the VAPID key and registers the device
a denied permission explains how to fix it and never re-prompts
a dismissed prompt stays disabled without subscribing
insecure origins and missing support are explained, not prompted
server without push reports an error and does not subscribe
test and disable are explicit actions against the stored endpoint
resync re-posts an existing subscription only after an explicit enable
?event=<id> is routed once and removed from the address bar

ui_sounds.name: sound is opt-in: muted by default and silent without a trusted gesture
one playback per eventId, shared by tabs of the same browser
no loops: loop cues are rejected and every play is one-shot
hidden pages are silent and stop sound; volume is clamped
preview works while muted only from a human gesture
